svg.title: KindredRelay architecture
svg.desc: How a caregiver update becomes a sourced family timeline: speech to text on CPU, photo reading and fact extraction on AMD Token Factory, a deterministic grounding check, an evidence verifier gate that is off in the release, and the family timeline; a question path that only chooses sentences; and, outside the app path, the fall detection module and evaluation harnesses.
